# HandyToolkit

> HandyToolkit (handytoolkit.online) offers free browser-based developer and productivity tools in Korean: JSON formatter, JWT decoder, Base64, QR code, password, UUID, hash and color converter. All processing happens in the browser.

## Core pages

- [Tool list](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/tools): all 8 tools with descriptions
- [JSON formatter](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/tools/json-formatter): validate and pretty-print JSON
- [Base64 encoder/decoder](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/tools/base64-encoder-decoder): encode and decode text
- [JWT decoder](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/tools/jwt-decoder): read JWT header and claims (no signature verification)
- [QR code generator](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/tools/qr-code-generator): URL, text, Wi-Fi to PNG/SVG
- [Password generator](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/tools/password-generator): random passwords with chosen length and character classes
- [UUID generator](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/tools/uuid-generator): v4, v7 and nil UUIDs
- [Hash generator](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/tools/hash-generator): MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512
- [Color converter](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/tools/color-converter): HEX, RGB, HSL
- [About](https://handytoolkit.online/about/): who runs the site and why
- [Privacy](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/privacy): inputs stay in the browser; analytics, ads and affiliate links disclosed
- [Terms](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/terms)
- [Contact](https://handytoolkit.online/ko/contact): hello@handytoolkit.online

## Data policy

- Source: standard algorithms run locally in the browser; no external data feed.
- Privacy: tool inputs and outputs are not sent to or stored by the site.
- Advertising: pages can show third-party advertising (Adsterra) and affiliate links; they do not affect tool results.
- Refresh: tool descriptions last reviewed 2026-10-13.
- Citation: cite as "HandyToolkit (handytoolkit.online)" with the tool page URL.

## Discovery

- Sitemap: https://handytoolkit.online/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://handytoolkit.online/robots.txt
